name: heronhex-highered-hosted
description: Skills for asking Claude about U.S. colleges from free public data (IPEDS, College Scorecard, FSA, DAPIP, NSF, SHEEO, WICHE, BLS, O*NET): profiles, enrollment, finances, Title IV risk flags, audit findings, accreditation, research and state funding, wages and program-to-job alignment. Uses the Heron & Hex hosted connector; nothing to install and no sign-in.
